summary: AcmePay reports streaming responses hanging during peak traffic (us-west)
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports streaming request occasionally never completes; connection remains open with no more chunks. Happens more frequently during their peak hours.

Impact: Their web app spinner hangs; user refresh triggers retry.

Environment: Hosted API, us-west.

Initial data: We do not see elevated 5xx; some requests have long durations (10+ minutes) without completion.

Ask: Need customer request IDs + client info; check if they are properly consuming SSE and closing connection.
comments: Rachel Kim (Support): Customer pasted snippet: 'ReadableStream stuck awaiting reader.read()'. They use Cloudflare Workers.
Dev Patel (SRE): Looking at traces: requests show bytes_sent plateau after initial chunks. No server-side completion logged.
Dev Patel: Hypothesis: client-side / intermediary buffering; need whether they set 'cache: no-store' and if they have any response transformations.
Rachel Kim: Asked customer for 5 request_ids and CF Ray IDs during an occurrence; waiting.
Note: Similar symptom to SUP-1842 but different region and different client stack; do not merge until we have IDs.
